identification_level_enum.MI: point identified under an explicit qualified model
identification_level_enum.NI: no qualified identified-set characterization currently available

exact_range_rule: quadratic image over a closed interval is evaluated at endpoints and any interior vertex

claim_rules.point_target_claim: allowed only for O or MI
claim_rules.downstream_decision_claim: allowed for PI when decision is stable and regularity is regular

fail_closed: uncharacterized NI target cannot be collapsed to a point
grid-only set image treated as proof

numerical_hardening.effect_radius_boundary: analytic substitution of frozen t into Delta(tu;s)=0
numerical_hardening.execution_boundary: post-v1 code hardening is not covered by the frozen v1 execution receipt

set_representation_enum.witness-only: admissible witnesses without a bound on the full identified set
set_representation_enum.inner-approximation: guaranteed subset of the true identified set
set_representation_enum.outer-approximation: guaranteed superset of the true identified set
set_representation_enum.sharp: exact identified set under declared assumptions

decision_claim_polarity.outer-approximation: stable can be certified; unstable cannot
decision_claim_polarity.inner-approximation: unstable can be certified; stable cannot
decision_claim_polarity.sharp: stable or unstable can be certified subject to regularity
decision_claim_polarity.witness-only: neither stable nor unstable can be certified
